facts.fact: Morocco World News reports that the Cash Plus and Damanesign qualified e-signature certificate service operates under Law 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions; no date for the law is given, so the article's publication date of 2026-10-01 is used.
facts.system: Law 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions

facts.fact: Morocco World News reports that Damanesign is a trust service provider approved by the DGSSI under Law 43-20 and issues qualified certificates for electronic signature and electronic seal; the approval date is not given, so the article's publication date of 2026-10-01 is used.
facts.system: Law 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions

systems.platform: qualified electronic signature and seal certificates on USB key
systems.owner: Damanesign (trust service provider approved by DGSSI)
systems.tiers: companies, public institutions, regulated professions, import-export operators
